target: observe.sh SubagentStop — one API response spans many transcript lines with a repeated usage object; the extraction must sum once per message id (the 2.28M-token field failure)
cmd:
mkdir -p .agentic; printf '%s' '{"observability":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; unset CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR AGENTIC_OBSERVE; { printf '%s
' '{"message":{"id":"m1","model":"test-model","usage":{"input_tokens":1000,"output_tokens":200,"cache_read_input_tokens":50,"cache_creation_input_tokens":10}}}'; printf '%s
' '{"message":{"id":"m1","model":"test-model","usage":{"input_tokens":1000,"output_tokens":200,"cache_read_input_tokens":50,"cache_creation_input_tokens":10}}}'; printf '%s
' '{"message":{"id":"m1","model":"test-model","usage":{"input_tokens":1000,"output_tokens":200,"cache_read_input_tokens":50,"cache_creation_input_tokens":10}}}'; printf '%s
' '{"message":{"id":"m2","model":"test-model","usage":{"input_tokens":2000,"output_tokens":300,"cache_read_input_tokens":0,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0}}}'; printf '%s
' '{"type":"tool_result","no_usage_here":true}'; printf '%s
' '{"usage":{"input_tokens":10,"output_tokens":5}}'; } > t.jsonl; printf '%s' "{"hook_event_name":"SubagentStop","session_id":"s1","agent_id":"ag1","agent_type":"loop-worker-cheap","transcript_path":"$PWD/t.jsonl","last_assistant_message":"done","cwd":"$PWD"}" | "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe.sh"; cat .agentic/observability/events-*.jsonl | tail -1

provenance.note: from the 254M-output-token anomaly found on the first real dashboard read; naive per-line summing would report 5010/905 here
